value.rationale: The logistic parameter four is the canonical real-chaotic case and binary16 is a standard low-precision format. Exact complete finite-state invariant cycle/basin spectra for two natural algebraically equivalent evaluation trees resolve a concrete numerical reproducibility gap; their period-5 versus period-8 and 12,513-edge contrast is substantial, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of Corless’s known period-40 graph. The precise basin counts quantify implementation sensitivity beyond sampled bifurcation plots.
